**GPT-3.5-Turbo with 20 documents:**

- **Answer document first (index 0):** 75.8% accuracy (Table 6, p. 18).
- **Worst position:** 53.8%, when the answer document is at index 9, the 10th of 20 positions, in the middle of the context (Table 6, p. 18). Table 6 reports only indices 0, 4, 9, 14 and 19, so this is the worst of those positions.
- **Compared with closed-book:** GPT-3.5-Turbo scores 56.1% closed-book, with no documents given (Table 1, p. 5). Its worst 20-document result is therefore 2.3 points lower than answering with no documents at all. The paper states this directly: "in the worst case, performance in 20- and 30-document settings is lower than performance without *any* input documents (i.e., closed-book performance; 56.1%)" (p. 5).

From first position to worst position, accuracy drops by 22.0 points (75.8% → 53.8%). This matches the paper's statement that GPT-3.5-Turbo's performance "can drop by more than 20%" (p. 5).
